title: Escondite Sur
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at “Escondite Sur”, a luxury 5-bed, 5.5-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 11 guests, this home offers a Private Pool & Spa, Game Room, Elevator & Golf Cart for your enjoyment. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights -Resort Style Private Heated Pool (Heating available for an additional $60 per day during the months of Oct 31-May 1) -Hot Tub -Rooftop Deck with Gulf Views -Short Walk to Beach Access -Elevator -6 Adult Bikes Included -6 seater Golf Cart included -Pet Friendly Escape to Escondite Sur, your ultimate vacation retreat along 30 in Santa Rosa Beach. This luxury property offers an unparalleled experience for those seeking the perfect beachside getaway. With just a short stroll, you'll find yourself sinking your toes into the sugary sands of Santa Rosa Beach. Enjoy the gentle Gulf breeze and endless horizons. Escondite Sur’s pristine, modern interior is bathed in natural light that streams in through floor to ceiling windows, illuminating the elegant wood floors throughout the home. The warm, natural ambiance created by this combination welcomes you to a world of comfort and relaxation. The heart of Escondite Sur is an expansive open concept living space. Relax by the cozy fireplace in the living area, perfect for those cooler evenings. The spacious design seamlessly connects the living room, dining area, and kitchen, creating a harmonious atmosphere for your group to gather and make lasting memories. The kitchen is a chef's dream, well equipped with sleek modern appliances, ample marble counters, and everything you need to prepare gourmet meals. With its ample storage and counter space, the butler's pantry adds an extra touch of sophistication and convenience to your stay. It's the perfect place to prepare drinks or lay out appetizers for guests. Share delicious meals and laughter in the dining area, where a large table provides ample seating for your entire party. Whether you're enjoying a homemade feast or takeout from one of the local restaurants, this space is perfect for communal dining. Convenience meets luxury with an elevator that takes you effortlessly between the floors, ensuring accessibility for everyone. For those looking for indoor entertainment, the billiards room awaits. Challenge your friends and family to a game of billiards while enjoying the convenience of sliders that open to the pool area. It's a space where fun and relaxation come together. Escondite Sur offers multiple decks across its four levels, each providing a unique perspective of the surroundings. Embrace the indoor-outdoor lifestyle with folding slider doors that seamlessly connect the living spaces to the decks on each level. These doors create a fluid transition, allowing you to enjoy the gentle coastal breeze and breathtaking views without leaving the comfort of the home. From the ground-level deck by the pool to the upper-level decks with stunning views, there's a perfect spot for every occasion. Enjoy your morning coffee, savor a sunset cocktail, or simply bask in the coastal breeze. Step outside to discover your own private oasis. Cook and entertain alfresco style in the well-equipped outdoor kitchen. Grill up your favorite dishes while savoring the fresh sea air. It's the ideal setting for barbecues and outdoor dining. Dive into pure relaxation in your own private heated pool or unwind in the soothing jacuzzi. Whether you're basking in the sun or stargazing at night, this outdoor retreat is a true gem. Ascend to the fourth level and discover the observation deck. Here, you can enjoy panoramic views of the surrounding area, including the beautiful coastline and breathtaking sunsets. It's the perfect spot for relaxation and reflection. Explore the charming surroundings on our six adult bikes, perfect for discovering hidden gems and scenic routes. Experience the convenience of a six-seater golf cart, making beach access and local adventures a breeze. Escondite Sur has thought of every detail to ensure your vacation is truly exceptional. It is your haven of luxury and comfort on the beautiful Florida coast. It's the ideal destination for families and friends looking to create unforgettable memories. Book your stay today and experience the epitome of beachside living. Sleeping Arrangements First Floor -Bunk Room - Twin over Queen Bunk - Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo Second Floor King Bedroom with Private Bathroom - Shower Only Queen Bedroom with Private Bathroom - Shower Only Master Bedroom with Private Bathroom - Shower and Soaking Tub Third Floor King Bedroom with Private Bathroom - Shower Only Half Bath *This home is pet-friendly, if approved, and with the addition of pet fees*
